originalIntent: Publish a complete physics_capture_v1 research-data contract and loader compatibility boundary with authoritative semantics, exact timing and provenance, opt-in legacy compatibility, and exact staged collection, promotion, and rollback commands.
desiredOutcome: Researchers can validate the published contract against the real schema and accepted staged artifacts, distinguish enriched supervision from legacy RGB-only data, and use exact atomic operational commands without modifying protected production paths during documentation validation.
userOutcomeReview: Confirmed. The final documentation contains the required authoritative sections under meaningful H2 boundaries, the verifier binds the named archive receipt to the archive bytes and accepted Task 8 report, and the named promotion and rollback blocks retain the exact atomic commands. The real CLI and six-test suite pass, while independent moved-section, renamed-receipt, moved-command, and report-mismatch probes fail closed.

slopAndProgrammingPass.production: No needless extraction, parsing, normalization, untyped escape hatch, broad exception handling, or scope drift that violates a stated Todo 9 criterion. The verifier is 248 pure LOC, below the 250-LOC ceiling.
slopAndProgrammingPass.tests: Six CLI-boundary tests use isolated temporary copies and assert observable failures. The removal mutations are criterion-directed semantic and operational adversaries, not tests of requested deletion, tautologies, or implementation-only mirrors. No excessive test volume or deletion-only production test was found.
slopAndProgrammingPass.reviewCoverage: task-9-independent-quality-rerun.md explicitly records both remove-ai-slops and programming perspectives, including overfit/slop and maintenance checks; this rerun independently reproduced that pass.

operationalSafety.note: A pre-existing Unity Licensing Client process was observed; this review did not start, stop, or interact with it.

notes: The verifier uses section-bound required semantic tokens rather than a full Markdown semantic parser. Independent moved-section probes show the stated structural regression class is enforced; this is not a blocker for the Todo 9 criterion.
